summary_en: 920,000 shares (16.14% of S/O) transferred from CEO Kazuya Okada to MJ-R LLC (asset management company with Okada as representative member) on 2026-06-01. MJ-R LLC shareholding rises from 17.74% to 33.89% (rank 2 to rank 1); Okada's direct holding falls from 40.79% to 24.65% (rank 1 to rank 2). Transfer constitutes acquisition of 5%+ voting stake, reportable as quasi-tender-offer acquisition under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Article 167(1) and Cabinet Order Article 31. No material impact on operations or results.
title_en: Notice of Change in Principal Shareholder and Notice of Share Acquisition Meeting Quasi-Tender-Offer Requirements
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-01, Landix disclosed that CEO Kazuya Okada transferred 920,000 shares (16.14% of outstanding shares) to MJ-R LLC, an asset management company where Okada serves as representative member. This transfer causes MJ-R LLC to become the principal (top-ranked) shareholder with 33.89% voting rights (up from 17.74%), while Okada's direct holding falls to 24.65% (rank 2, down from 40.79%). The company characterizes this as a quasi-tender-offer acquisition reportable under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Article 167(1) and Cabinet Order Article 31 because it involves acquisition of 5%+ voting stake. The transfer is stated to have no material impact on company operations or financial results, as it represents a restructuring of ownership between related parties under common control.
